info.title: Proton VPN API
info.description: One versioned API for the WebUI and scripts. Configure API_KEY separately from WEBUI_PASSWORD. WEBUI_ALLOWED_NETWORKS, when set, is checked first on every route, including this document; clients outside it cannot connect. Protected routes accept a valid bearer key, valid session cookie, or access while WEBUI_PASSWORD is empty. This document and POST /api/v1/login need no prior authentication. An empty API_KEY disables bearer authentication, not open-mode access. Only valid bearer-authenticated writes bypass X-Requested-With. All POSTs require a JSON object (maximum 8192 bytes). Use HTTPS via a trusted reverse proxy outside a trusted local network. Errors use {"error": "message"}; no legacy error fields.

get.description: Snapshot-only metrics in Prometheus 0.0.4 text format: protonvpn_signed_in, protonvpn_connected, protonvpn_tunnel_healthy, protonvpn_user_disconnected, protonvpn_port_forwarding_active and protonvpn_health_check_age_seconds gauges; protonvpn_receive_bytes_total and protonvpn_transmit_bytes_total counters; protonvpn_connect_attempts_total, protonvpn_connect_failures_total, protonvpn_recovery_attempts_total, protonvpn_health_checks_total and protonvpn_health_check_failures_total counters since the container started. Boolean gauges are 0 or 1; tunnel health is 0 when unknown, port forwarding is active only while a port is advertised, and health-check age is omitted until a check completes. Byte counters cover the current connection's WireGuard interface, restart at each connection (use rate() for bytes per second) and are omitted until the first traffic sample. Traffic checks run every 30 seconds while signed in and not user-disconnected; while that tunnel is not connected, each check counts as failed without probing. No account, IP, server or error labels are exported. Unhealthy VPN states still return 200; use the gauges and counters for VPN alerts and up for scrape failures. Uses the same authentication and network restrictions as the JSON API.

200.description: Current VPN state, including unhealthy or unknown states

text/plain.example:
# HELP protonvpn_signed_in Whether Proton VPN is signed in.
# TYPE protonvpn_signed_in gauge
protonvpn_signed_in 1
# HELP protonvpn_connected Whether the CLI reports a connected tunnel.
# TYPE protonvpn_connected gauge
protonvpn_connected 1
# HELP protonvpn_tunnel_healthy Whether the tunnel has a fresh passing traffic check.
# TYPE protonvpn_tunnel_healthy gauge
protonvpn_tunnel_healthy 1
# HELP protonvpn_user_disconnected Whether automatic connection is paused by a user disconnect.
# TYPE protonvpn_user_disconnected gauge
protonvpn_user_disconnected 0
# HELP protonvpn_port_forwarding_active Whether a forwarded port is currently advertised.
# TYPE protonvpn_port_forwarding_active gauge
protonvpn_port_forwarding_active 0
# HELP protonvpn_health_check_age_seconds Seconds since the last traffic check.
# TYPE protonvpn_health_check_age_seconds gauge
protonvpn_health_check_age_seconds 4.5
# HELP protonvpn_receive_bytes_total Bytes received through the tunnel on the current connection.
# TYPE protonvpn_receive_bytes_total counter
protonvpn_receive_bytes_total 1500
# HELP protonvpn_transmit_bytes_total Bytes sent through the tunnel on the current connection.
# TYPE protonvpn_transmit_bytes_total counter
protonvpn_transmit_bytes_total 2600

get.description: Current account, CLI connection, forwarded port and traffic check. Empty strings mean unavailable. connected is the CLI state; tunnel_healthy is the traffic check and is never true without a fresh passing probe.
Null when unavailable. With format=text, returns a bare port number or an empty body.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Use text for shell scripts; otherwise JSON.

get.description: Last 15 minutes. Samples are [relative_seconds, received_bytes, sent_bytes]; newest sample is at 0 seconds. Totals are since connection, zero without samples.
Every setting with value, lock, source and kind. Choice settings include allowed choices; bool values use true or false. Environment values are read-only. No WebUI password or API key is exposed.

post.description: Validates and applies one setting. Environment-locked settings return 409; CLI rejection returns 422.

post.description: Checks WEBUI_PASSWORD and sets the HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session cookie. API_KEY does not replace the password here. Open mode is a no-op. Five failed logins per minute trigger a 60-second lockout.

tunnel_healthy.description: True only while connected and the last successful IPv4 HTTPS probe through the tunnel is at most 60 seconds old. Null while connected but not yet checked. False when disconnected, failed or stale.

health_error.description: Short reason for the last failed traffic check. Empty when there is none.

health_checked_ago.description: Seconds since the last completed traffic check of the current connection. Null when there is none.

value.description: Empty clears the saved value. Choice values come from GET /settings; bool values are true or false. CUSTOM_DNS: off, on, or on --dns <comma-separated IPs>. Target fields must not start with a dash; control characters are rejected.
